ingredients.title: Filling
items: 1 small pkg instant coconut cream pudding

instructions.title: Pretzels
items: Put broken pretzels in a 9x13 pan.
Melt butter and sugar together and pour over pretzels.

instructions.title: Filling
items: Cream together cream cheese and pineapple juice by adding the juice gradually to the cream cheese and beating it in a little at a time.
Add the pineapple and pudding mix and mix thoroughly.
Stir in the pretzels and marshmallows right before serving.
